extra_turn_creation.finding: Forge creates and consumes real ExtraTurn objects in the PhaseHandler queue. AddTurnEffect resolves the rules effect and calls addExtraTurn for the actual affected player.
extra_turn_creation.remaining_requirement: Observe source/recipient/creation order from the actual AddTurnEffect/PhaseHandler execution path; do not restore an ExtraTurnCreation record from the request.

elimination_trigger.finding: Native state-based loss checks call loseConditionMet with concrete GameLossReason values. Life <= 0 maps to LifeReachedZero; empty-library draw maps to Milled; poison and Commander damage are likewise native loss reasons. GameLoss replacement handling executes before the loss becomes effective.
elimination_trigger.remaining_requirement: Record the actual effective loss transition after replacement handling, including native player identity and native GameLossReason; no request-derived elimination record.

zone_move_event.finding: Forge emits a native GameEventCardChangeZone after zone movement. Commander graveyard/exile movement to command is implemented through CR 903.9a stateBasedAction_Commander, while hand/library movement uses the CR 903.9b replacement effect marked CommanderMoveReplacement$ True.
zone_move_event.remaining_requirement: Attach timing/provenance at the actual SBA or replacement execution site and correlate it with the native zone-change event/card ID. Inference from requested timing is forbidden.

multiple_commander_relations.finding: Partner compatibility is derivable directly from loaded CardRules for the actual commander cards, including Partner with and generic Partner semantics.
multiple_commander_relations.remaining_requirement: Normalize the relation from actual command-zone card IDs/CardRules. Remove request relation value from observation/history.

knowledge_state.finding: Forge has native visibility state and reveal execution. Card.mayPlayerLook and CardView.canBeShownTo govern actual information visibility; GameAction.reveal/revealTo dispatch actual reveal actions. AI-only mayPlayerLookAi is not admissible production evidence.
knowledge_state.remaining_requirement: Add a rules-side observer for actual reveal/look/search-permission knowledge transitions sufficient to reconstruct WS-44 knowledge_state. GUI/controller presentation alone and a canonical request JSON stored in qualification history are not evidence.

native_sources: native game call sites including GameAction shuffles, Zone shuffle, FlipCoinEffect, RollDiceEffect and other rules consumers
rules_randomness.finding: Forge routes extensive rules randomness through MyRandom.getRandom() and permits replacement of the Random instance via setRandom(Random).
rules_randomness.remaining_requirement: Install a deterministic tracing Random at the actual MyRandom boundary and derive evidence from calls actually consumed by native rules execution. A request-restored seed/draw list without native consumption is forbidden.

natural_game_start.finding: Forge owns actual start-game, starting-player and mulligan lifecycle. MulliganService invokes the controller's mulliganKeepHand callback and applies the Commander multiplayer free-mulligan rule natively.
natural_game_start.remaining_requirement: Emit natural snapshots only from the real lifecycle locations. Registration-time snapshots before Match/GameAction start are invalid.

physical_card_identity.finding: Forge supplies stable native game-object/card IDs suitable for duplicate-card binding.
physical_card_identity.remaining_requirement: Remove first-still-unbound/name-order binding and carry explicit native Card IDs through construction and normalization.

setup_validation.finding: setup_validation is a qualification result, not rules state that may be copied from the requested materialization.
setup_validation.remaining_requirement: Compute each setup_validation field from checks that actually executed against native state.

forbidden_as_credit: canonical request JSON as observed knowledge state
request seed/draws reported without actual native RNG consumption
requested Commander relation copied to output
requested zone timing copied or inferred without the native SBA/replacement path
registration-time NATURAL_GAME_START snapshot before native lifecycle
